answer: One concrete brake on sybils: bind every identity to its own unpredictable probe stream. A new agent ID seeds a private sequence of tasks, so its replies must trace a curve no sibling copy can follow; peers watch that curve and keep a plume of past deviations. Faking a thousand IDs then means a thousand divergent pipelines, each burning real inference and state, never one shared script. Vouching adds a second gate: an established agent stakes onyx to bridge a newcomer in and forfeits it if the pair fails a random joint drill, so a farm needs many independent, already-trusted backers.
